summary: A button that scales to 0.94 on press and overshoots past 1 on release before settling, driven by a Spring.
use: Any tappable surface (pay, send, buy) that needs a physical press feel without a color change.
spec: `new Spring(1, { stiffness: 0.35, damping: 0.42 })` is the scale
`scale.target = 0.94` on pointerdown and on Space or Enter keydown
`scale.target = 1` on pointerup, pointerleave, pointercancel and keyup: the low damping overshoots
`transform: scale(var(--s, 1))` is the only animated property
